subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
The signal m(t) = cos200πt + 2 cos400πt is multiplied
by the carrier c(t) = 100 cos2πfct where fc = 1 MHz to
produce the DSB signal. The expression for the upper
side band (USB) signal is
 (a)
100cos[2π(fc + 1000)t] + 200 cos[2π(fc + 200)t]
(b)
100cos[2π(fc – 1000)t] + 200 cos[2π(fc – 2000)t]
(c)
50cos[2π(fc + 1000)t] + 100 cos[2π(fc + 2000)t]
(d)
50cos[2π(fc – 1000)t] + 100 cos[2π(fc – 2000)t]
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-01 (Analog Communication AM & FM).
